title: 小乐拜师记 · 马桶刷第一课

JIALING.label: a 17-year-old Chinese high school girl with wavy auburn-red hair, Asian oval face, single eyelids, cool detached big-sister aura, wearing Hogwarts style dark robe, red and yellow striped scarf, grey pleated skirt, holding a wooden wand
JIALING.picture_retention: fully_preserved - face, auburn-red wavy hair, robe, scarf
JIALING.note: the senior female teacher (identical in all shots)

XIAOLE.label: a 7-year-old Chinese boy, second grade, short black hair, transparent-frame glasses, wearing an oversized Gryffindor style wizard robe, excited goofy face, holding a toilet brush like a wand
XIAOLE.picture_retention: fully_preserved - boy face, glasses, robe, toilet brush
XIAOLE.note: the novice apprentice (identical in all shots)

HALL.label: an old Hogwarts style magic school hall: ancient stone walls, tall arched arched windows with amber stained glass, floating candles, long wooden tables, raised wooden podium, warm torchlight
HALL.picture_retention: fully_preserved - stone walls, candles, tables, warm light

ROOSTER.label: a realistic large farm rooster with bright red serrated comb and wattle, rich orange-red breast and neck feathers, dark green iridescent tail feathers, brown body, sturdy legs with spurs, photorealistic animal matching the photographic scene style
ROOSTER.picture_retention: fully_preserved - red comb, orange-red neck, green tail, body shape
ROOSTER.note: the realistic rooster (transformed from paper crane, identical in all rooster shots)

shots.name: shot01
shots.dialogue: 今天先教你基础施法，首先，要学会正确拿捏魔法棒的手法。要认真听哦，钟启乐！
shots.speaker: S1
shots.action: [Shot 1] In the old magic school hall, [Subject 1], the senior girl teacher, stands behind the podium holding a wooden wand, then leans down toward [Subject 2], the little apprentice boy sitting upright in his seat, and speaks to him seriously. The boy nods earnestly. [Subject 3] fills the background with warm candlelight and a magical atmosphere.
shots.sound: quiet hall ambience, soft footsteps, faint candle flicker

zh.action: 嘉玲双手背后站在讲台，弯下腰对小乐法师说到，小乐法师端正坐在座位，一脸正经得点点头回应
zh.sound: 安静的礼堂环境音，轻柔的脚步声，蜡烛微弱的闪烁声
zh.music: 轻快的俏皮钢琴曲，带喜剧感

shots.name: shot02
shots.dialogue: 念咒的时候要集中精神，把法力和意志一同传递到法杖，就像这样：马里马里轰！
shots.speaker: S1
shots.action: [Shot 1] [Subject 1] calmly demonstrates a spell: she flicks her wooden wand, a thin golden arc of light traces through the air, controlled and elegant. Her expression stays cool. She turns slightly toward [Subject 2] to show him.

zh.action: 嘉玲平静地演示咒语：轻挥木魔杖，一道细长的金色弧光划过空中，克制而优雅。她神情保持冷静，向旁边的一个纸鹤施法，那个纸鹤突然像活了一样，周围有一些特效能量，扇了扇翅膀
zh.sound: 轻微的魔法微光声，礼堂环境音
zh.music: 沉稳优雅的钢琴曲，随后转向喜剧

shots.name: shot03
shots.dialogue: 哇哇哇，好好玩！姐姐好厉害！
shots.speaker: S2
shots.action: [Shot 1] [Subject 1], the little boy in the oversized wizard robe, holds up the toilet brush like a wand, takes a big breath until his face turns red, and shouts the spell loudly, waving the brush wildly. A few small soap bubbles pop out. Comedic and clumsy.
shots.sound: boy shouting (S2), bubble pops, hall echo

zh.action: 纸鹤在教堂空中飞翔盘旋，像一只鲜活的小鸽子一般，小乐看着开心，兴奋，惊讶，镜头要随着纸鹤一起废气，也能看到小乐开心的表情
zh.sound: 男孩大喊（小乐），泡泡破裂声，礼堂回声
zh.music: 渐强的喜剧配乐，随后转入闹剧式

shots.name: shot04
shots.dialogue: 嘉玲姐姐，我也来。马里马里轰！
shots.speaker: S2
shots.action: [Shot 1] The spell backfires: the toilet brush spins out of [Subject 1]'s hand, a burst of soap bubbles explodes everywhere, and he is knocked flat onto his back by his own magic. He yelps as he falls, glasses askew. Comic timing. The flying paper crane transforms mid-air into a realistic large farm rooster matching [Picture 3] (bright red comb, orange-red neck feathers, dark green iridescent tail), it flaps its wings and lets out a loud clucking crow. Photorealistic rooster matching the photographic scene style, no cartoon, no 3D render.
shots.sound: boy yelp (S2), bubbles bursting, comedic thud

zh.action: 小乐也很自信得拿起马桶刷，念起了咒语，指向另一只纸鹤，纸鹤变身后是一只和参考图一模一样的写实公鸡（红冠、橙红颈羽、深绿尾羽），扇了扇翅膀，发出了鸡鸣
zh.sound: 男孩惊叫（小乐），泡泡炸裂声，公鸡打鸣，喜剧式的闷响
zh.music: 闹剧配乐，滑稽的滑音音效

shots.name: shot05
shots.dialogue: 你这。。。是马桶刷？啊哈哈哈哈！
shots.speaker: S1
shots.action: [Shot 1] [Subject 1] (the senior girl teacher, 17-year-old, wavy auburn-red hair) looks down at [Subject 2] (the little boy) sprawled on the floor surrounded by soap bubbles, then at the toilet brush on the ground. Her expression is deadpan, one eyebrow twitching slightly. She speaks the line to the boy first, then she sighs quietly and bursts out laughing, clutching her stomach. The boy's mouth is closed, he stays silent and just looks embarrassed. Warm candlelight, comedic pause. THE GIRL (Subject 1) is the only one who speaks this line.
shots.sound: quiet hall, a soft sigh, bubble fizz
shots.music: deadpan comedy beat, one soft piano note

zh.action: 嘉玲（高三大女孩）低头看着摔在地上、周围满是泡泡的小乐和地上的马桶刷。她先对小乐说出台词，然后冷面叹气，再捧腹大笑。小乐全程闭嘴不说话，只露出尴尬表情
zh.sound: 安静的礼堂，一声轻叹，嘉玲大笑，泡泡嘶嘶声
zh.music: 冷面笑匠式喜剧拍点，配一个轻柔的钢琴单音

shots.name: shot06
shots.dialogue: 这是我家里能找到最像法杖的工具了。。。
shots.speaker: S2
shots.action: [Shot 1] [Subject 1] scrambles back up, dusts himself off with a goofy proud grin, and gives a thumbs-up. He looks up hopefully, eyes sparkling behind his crooked glasses. The realistic ground rooster (same as [Picture 3]: bright red comb, orange-red neck, dark green iridescent tail, matching the photographic scene style) flutters weakly with chicken sounds, then falls back down clumsily, like a chicken that cannot fly. Photorealistic rooster, no cartoon, no 3D render.
shots.sound: boy voice (S2), happy excited tone, hall ambience

zh.action: 小乐不好意思摸了摸脑袋，不好意思回应着嘉玲；同时参考图同款的写实公鸡咯咯叫、扑腾翅膀想飞但飞不起来，笨拙地摔回地上，像一只不会飞的鸡
zh.sound: 男孩说话声（小乐），兴奋愉快的语气，公鸡扑翅声，礼堂环境音

shots.name: shot07
shots.dialogue: 你已经做得很棒啦钟启乐，至少你的公鸡可以每天早上喊你起床啦！哈哈哈
shots.speaker: S1
shots.action: [Shot 1] [Subject 1] (the senior girl teacher, 17-year-old, wavy auburn-red hair) smiles and pats [Subject 2] (the little boy)'s head warmly, comforting him. SHE (Subject 1) speaks this line to the boy first. The little boy keeps his mouth closed and stays silent, just looking up at the senior girl with a hopeful grin. In the background, the realistic rooster (same as [Picture 4]: bright red comb, orange-red neck feathers, dark green iridescent tail, photorealistic matching the photographic scene style) keeps crowing loudly with a head-tilt. THE GIRL (Subject 1) is the only one who speaks this line. Photorealistic rooster, no cartoon, no 3D render.
shots.sound: boy cheer (S2), soft flame crackle, hall ambience

zh.action: 嘉玲（高三大女孩）乐呵呵得摸着小乐的头，安慰他，对他说出台词；小乐全程闭嘴不说话，只抬头露出期望的笑容；背景里那只写实公鸡还在高亢地打鸣。。。
zh.sound: 嘉玲说话声，公鸡打鸣，礼堂环境音
